claims.text: For boundary case \((p,c)=(1,1)\), with row order \((2),(3),(4)\) and column order \((x_2,z,y_2)\), the boundary matrix is \[ B_{1,1}= \begin{pmatrix} 0&1&1\\ 1&1&0\\ 0&1&1 \end{pmatrix}_{(x_2,z,y_2)}. \] Rows \((2),(3)\) restricted to columns \((z,y_2)\) are \[ \begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}, \qquad \det=(1)(0)-(1)(1)=-1\in\mathbb Z^\times. \] Moreover rows \((2)\) and \((4)\) are equal, both being \((0,1,1)\).
